request: Make viewer navigation intuitive, minimal and visual: one-click frame thumbnail grid; subtle component callouts with hover highlighting, touch selection, and contextual frame explorer.
scope: Viewer UI and concise English guides; existing public main and Pages. No changes to CAD, PCB, catalog, configuration format or hardware acceptance.
acceptance: All six actual-mesh frame thumbnails apply immediately
Per-half styles and colors, mixed state, JSON import/default reset stay synchronized
Component labels follow visible surfaces and highlight without affecting GLB
Mouse, keyboard and touch reach the same component information; frame selection opens contextual choices
All layers, cameras, KLP checks, JSON, GLB and offline behavior remain available
Published page and source match tested artifacts

review.agreement: Proceed with a bounded viewer-only redesign subject to the recorded safeguards.

dispositions.finding: HIGH: highlight could leak through shared material or mesh hierarchy into GLB
dispositions.resolution: Separate overlay group outside exported objects; original materials remain immutable; export color and geometry checks run while a part is selected.

dispositions.finding: HIGH/MEDIUM: asymmetric configurations and stale controls
dispositions.resolution: Derive card and color state from current configuration after each mutation/target switch/import; mixed states explicit; style changes preserve colors.

dispositions.finding: MEDIUM: touch, keyboard and orbit conflict
dispositions.resolution: Semantic buttons, focus highlights, roving tabs, tap movement threshold, multitouch/cancel suppression and Escape dismissal.
Raycast visible surfaces, update after view/geometry changes, two mobile labels and all components retained in Parts.
One reused WebGL renderer for cached startup thumbnails; on-demand rendering, cached anchor projection and requestAnimationFrame-throttled picking.
